nodes.title: Google Sheets as a live contact source: a tab read through the workspace's service account, or a published CSV link, on the same preview, receipt, mapping reuse and timed sync as the CRM imports; read only
nodes.details: Service account: workspace's google_workspace integration (service_account_json). An RS256 JWT for spreadsheets.readonly buys a token; Sheets v4 lists the GRID tabs and reads values (FORMATTED_VALUE, ragged rows handled). Published link: docs.google.com only, CSV output only, redirects only within Google, 20 MB cap. A 403 names the service-account address to share with. Tools source.sheet.tabs (read) and source.sheet.pull (draft); source.sync, source.sync.schedule and source.crm.sources take sheet sources; the intake.crm_sync job runs them. Web: From Google Sheets tab. Tests: intake-sheets 3/3 against a fake that verifies the JWT signature with the matching public key; e2e flow (published link, save, timer); axe screen. Not verified: a real Google sheet.

nodes.title: A Google Sheet has no stable row id, so it dedupes on the phone number like a file. A sync re-reads the whole tab with the last mapping; unchanged rows count as unchanged, and a changed number is a new person, not a flagged change as with a CRM.
nodes.rationale: Row positions shift when people sort or insert rows, so a row number would mis-key people. The number is what intake already dedupes on for files.
nodes.reverse_if: Buyers keep an id column in their sheets and want number changes flagged; then let a sheet name its id column and reuse the CRM idempotency (intake_crm_record).

nodes.title:
Google Sheets: 3/3 server tests and a browser flow.
- JWT: header and claims as documented, signature verified by the fake with the public key.
- Tabs: charts left out.
- Values: a blank row is not a person; a sync after an edit counts 1 updated and 2 unchanged; the timed job picks up a new row.
- Refusals: an unshared sheet names the address; another host, an HTML page and missing arguments are refused.
- Read only.
Plus e2e 91/92 (1 skipped: payments awaiting workspace's kinds).
nodes.method: node:test on a fresh Postgres with a local fake (tests/intake-sheets.test.ts); Playwright via e2e/run.sh with dev/fake-crm.mjs serving a published CSV
nodes.not_verified: A real Google sheet or service account; the googleusercontent redirect host.
